jobs.title: MEP Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Palamoottil Infrastructure is a leading organization specializing in plumbing, sanitation, and firefighting projects for residential buildings, commercial complexes, industrial facilities, luxury hotels, and educational institutions. The company is supported by dedicated, experienced, and skilled employees who manage a wide range of project types from concept to completion. Palamoottil Infrastructure is a licensed firefighting agency recognized by the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire Services, Government of Maharashtra. It also holds official plumbing licenses from the Government of Maharashtra State, underscoring its compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices. The company focuses on delivering reliable, safe, and efficient building infrastructure solutions for diverse clients.

Role Description
The Project Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing Mechanical and Plumbing activities across multiple construction and infrastructure projects. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and coordinating MEP works, managing project schedules and budgets, reviewing and approving technical submittals, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The MEP Project Manager will collaborate with design teams, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues, optimize resource allocation, and maintain project quality. The role also involves monitoring project progress, preparing status reports, mitigating risks, and supporting the timely completion of plumbing, sanitation, and firefighting systems. Remote work will require effective communication, documentation, and use of digital project management tools.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Mechanical and Plumbing knowledge, including practical experience in coordinating building services.
Candidates should possess hands-on skills and working experience in Plumbing systems relevant to residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
Candidates should possess solid Project Management and Budgeting skills to plan, track, and deliver projects within time and cost targets.
Candidates should possess experience with technical Submittals, including reviewing drawings, specifications, and vendor documentation.
Candidates should possess proficiency with project management software, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
Candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications in project management (e.g., PMP) or MEP disciplines are an advantage.
Candidates should possess knowledge of relevant building codes, safety standards, and firefighting / sanitation regulations; prior experience in large-scale construction or infrastructure projects is preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Warsaw, Poland

We are seeking an experienced and delivery-focused Project Manager to support the execution of the one of IQVIA's strategic initiatives focused on building a unified, AI-ready data foundation for healthcare data products and services.

This role will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business stakeholders to drive successful delivery across multiple workstreams, ensuring transparency, execution discipline, and predictable outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management capabilities with a passion for continuous improvement, modern delivery practices, and technology-enabled ways of working. We are looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape the future of delivery operations through practical applications of AI, automation, and emerging technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Lead planning, execution, and governance of strategic initiatives within the C360 program.
Manage project scope, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery reporting.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful execution.
Proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks and remove execution blockers.
Drive cross-functional collaboration and facilitate effective decision-making.
Support resource planning, prioritization, and delivery health reviews.
Establish and maintain clear communication with stakeholders, including executive leadership.
Champion modern project delivery practices and continuously improve ways of working.
Identify process improvement opportunities and lead initiatives that increase delivery effectiveness, predictability, and operational efficiency.
Leverage AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven insights to improve delivery visibility, operational performance, and decision-making.

Desired Experience & Skills

Substantial Project Management experience delivering complex software, data, platform, or technology initiatives.
Proven experience managing cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data, and Business organizations.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with senior leadership.
Experience working within Agile and Scrum delivery frameworks.
Demonstrated experience driving process improvement, operational excellence, or organizational transformation initiatives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, and modern delivery management tools.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
Experience applying data-driven approaches to delivery management and operational improvement.
Demonstrated passion for transforming delivery organizations through AI-enabled ways of working, automation, and continuous innovation.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience leading cross-functional delivery initiatives involving technical and non-technical teams.
Project Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent) preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Why Join?

Those who join us become part of a recognized global leader still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care. You will have access to the most cutting-edge technology, the largest data sets, the best analytics tools and, in our opinion, some of the finest minds in the Healthcare industry.

You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.

Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.

It's an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.

IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success. We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential .

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is zł160,200.00 - zł297,300.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Project Manager [AQ-28242]
jobs.description:
Aquent Studios has partnered with one of the world’s most admired and innovative pharmaceutical companies to find a dynamic professional ready to make a significant impact on global healthcare communications. In this role, you will be at the heart of ensuring that vital commercial assets and educational materials are seamlessly, compliantly, and efficiently guided through their lifecycle. Your work will directly support the launch of life-changing therapies and ensure that critical, accurate information reaches healthcare providers and patients safely and swiftly.

About The Partner Company

Our client is a global healthcare pioneer dedicated to reimagining medicine to improve and extend people’s lives. By leveraging breakthrough science and digital technologies, they address some of society’s most challenging healthcare issues. Through Aquent Studios’ custom-built agency partnership, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent, drive operational excellence, and contribute to a culture of innovation and high performance.

The Opportunity

As a key player in the Material Approval Process (MAP), you will drive operational excellence by managing end-to-end critical tasks for commercial assets. From initial submission to compliant withdrawal from the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, you will navigate project obstacles, collaborate cross-functionally, and ensure absolute compliance with industry standards. This is an exciting opportunity to showcase your project management agility, solve complex workflow challenges, and play a vital role in high-profile product launches, campaigns, and major industry events.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Material Approval Process (MAP) for urgent public relations, market access, training, communications, and other key submissions by reviewing assets for readiness, ensuring metadata accuracy, and routing to appropriate reviewers.
Collaborate closely with Content Owners to manage inventory workflows, ensuring all commercial materials are proactively expired and compliantly removed from the market and DAM systems.
Drive the creation and maintenance of project forecasts to ensure flawless planning and execution for major milestones, including product launches, label updates, promotional campaigns, and major congresses.
Actively participate in status and review meetings to keep projects on track, aligned with compliance standards, and moving forward efficiently.
Troubleshoot system challenges for internal and external partners, providing solutions, guidance, and best practices as technology platforms evolve.
Identify process optimization opportunities based on user experience and emerging agency technologies.

Required Qualifications

A 4-year college degree, preferably with a focus in Business, Marketing, or Communications.
2 to 4 years of experience in pharmaceutical advertising, marketing, communications, or digital/content strategy.
Working knowledge of FDA and pharmaceutical regulatory and compliance guidelines for advertising and promotion.
Strong project management skills with a proven track record of managing timelines and cross-functional collaboration.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Adobe Acrobat, and content review software, along with excellent organizational skills and meeting hygiene.

Preferred Qualifications

Functional experience in pharmaceutical marketing operations.
A solid understanding of the pharmaceutical review and approval process.
Experience using Aprimo Marketing Studio or similar content review and digital asset management platforms.

Client Description

Aquent Studios is a global creative studio that delivers scale, speed and efficiency to the world’s most recognized brands. We create the work that matters the most to them—work that has a real impact on their business. As an Aquent Studio team member, you’ll have the opportunity to engage with the largest and most influential companies in the world, solving design challenges and extending their brands across tactic types and platforms, including digital design, UI/UX, video, motion, content, print design, web development, and more. If you want to do work that matters in a collaborative setting that values ingenuity and personal growth, you have found the right place!

jobs.description:
Location:
Serbia - EOR

Description

Gravity Global is the world’s most awarded marketing consultancy, specialising in brands operating in complex markets. Led by strategy, innovation, technology, data, and creativity, we create brand-and-demand marketing programmes that drive transformational growth for our clients, from initial insight and positioning through to integrated campaign execution.

With 14 wholly owned offices across the US, Europe, and APAC, you can develop a truly global career in a rapidly scaling organisation, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and international clients across multiple time zones and markets.

We are searching for a Project Manager with creative production experience who will be responsible for planning and delivering projects from initiation through completion, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to client and business objectives. You will coordinate the end-to-end delivery of creative assets and campaigns (for example digital banners, brochures, videos, statics, socials), manage schedules, resources and budgets, and act as a key point of contact between internal teams and clients to keep projects moving smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple projects, managing plans, schedules, budgets, resources and project documentation.
Track project health, risks, issues and dependencies, and ensure deliverables meet agreed timelines and quality standards.
Coordinate stakeholders and project teams, keeping communication clear and expectations aligned. Act as a day-to-day client contact where agreed with Client Services.
Contribute to project scoping, estimating and planning, and support strong client relationships.
Review completed projects, identify opportunities to improve, and help develop our delivery processes, tools and ways of working.
Bring curiosity about AI-powered tools and build your AI literacy, using relevant technologies to support efficient, high-quality delivery.
Encourage collaboration and consistent delivery standards, and support junior colleagues and project coordinators.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What you'l bring;
3–6 years’ project management experience, ideally in an agency environment.
Experience managing several mid-sized projects at the same time.
Strong organisation and prioritisation, with the ability to manage budgets, timelines and resources across multiple workstreams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and confidence working with clients and stakeholders.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana.
A proactive, solutions-focused approach; calmness under pressure; a strong sense of ownership; and a collaborative, dependable working style.

Nice to have
PMP, PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster or an equivalent qualification.
A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field.
Familiarity with marketing technology platforms, production tools or analytics tools.

What we can offer:

While specific benefits may vary by region due to cultural norms, all team members at Gravity Global can expect a supportive, inclusive, and rewarding environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career.

Key aspects of being part of the Gravity Global community:
💰 Competitive Reward & Pay –
we recognise and value your contribution with fair and competitive rewards aligned to local market practices, designed to celebrate excellence and support long-term success.
🚀 Career Growth & Development –
we believe development is ongoing, not annual. Through our Continuous Performance Management (CPM) process, which includes regular feedback and coaching, we help you refine your skills, celebrate your achievements, and plan for future success enabling you to reach your full potential.
🤝 Collaboration –
be part of a cross-functional, global team that values sharing insights, ideas, and best practices to drive collective success.
🎓 Professional Development –
we invest in you through ongoing training and learning programmes designed to expand your expertise and confidence.
🌴 Work-Life Balance –
while we expect dedication to client success, we also value your wellbeing, offering flexible working arrangements and plentiful paid time off.
🎉 Community & Recognition –
we celebrate our people through social and team-building events, recognise length of service and life milestones, and appreciate individual contributions through our Gravity Gratitude ‘kudos’ recognition programme.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family Support –
we understand family matters and our people benefit from family-friendly policies such as parental leave, and access to wellbeing resources to help you balance work and family life.
🌱 Purpose & Belonging –
we are committed to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles, fostering a workplace where positive impact matters. Our people are encouraged to get involved in employee resource groups that champion wellbeing, sustainability and culture.

Important Disclosure:

At Gravity Global, we believe in recognising every team member’s contribution. Your total rewards package – including salary and benefits – will align with country specific labor laws and our company policies. We’ll walk you through all the details during the offer stage.

Gravity Global is an equal opportunities employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion, age, sexuality, disability and other protected status as required by applicable law.

If your experience doesn't align perfectly with the job criteria, but you meet some of the criteria and are excited about the role and Gravity, please don't be put off applying! We would encourage you to apply for the role as you may be just the right person for this role or other roles.

jobs.title: Senior Global Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Senior Global Project Manager

Be Part of One Team, One Purpose.

At Emmes Group
, we’re shaping the future of clinical research— where human intelligence meets cutting-edge technology
to drive meaningful advancements in healthcare. With over 47 years of scientific excellence
, we’ve led groundbreaking research in cell and gene therapy, vaccines, infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.

Through our two business units— Emmes, a full-service CRO
, and Veridix AI, our technology, data, and analytical solutions
—we are modernizing clinical trials and accelerating the development of life-changing therapies.

We believe that every clinical breakthrough starts with people
—people who are passionate, purpose-driven, and ready to make an impact.
At Emmes Group, we bring People, Science, and Technology together to collaborate with our customers and deliver global health impact.
Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and innovation
, ensuring that every challenge is met with perseverance and accountability.

The Sr. Global Project Manager (SGPM) is critical to the successful conduct of Biopharmaceutical-sponsored clinical trials as a matrix leader of the core project team. The SGPM is responsible for the successful delivery of a Biopharmaceutical project(s). The SGPM will be client-facing and serve as the internal lead of the project through the life cycle of the study, ensuring effective project delivery in agreement with contracted project timeline and budget. The SGPM directs project delivery by driving team and financial efficiency, work product quality, and is responsible for client satisfaction through strong relationship management.

Responsibilities

May serve as a primary lead for major project bids and multi trial initiatives.
Ensures that deliverables for assigned project(s) are completed according to the contract budget, schedule, and quality standards. Effectively manages projects in all areas of performance.
Develops strong working relationships with clients, executive management, and project staff.
Collaborates with stakeholders to manage project issues, proactively identify and mitigate risks and drive milestone achievement.
Serves as the primary point of contact for biopharma clients and demonstrates proficiency in knowledge and understanding of client needs.
Proactively prepares/presents study metrics to maintain transparency for internal/external stakeholders.
Tracks project deliverables against contract using Emmes' tools.
Leads execution of contract amendments/change orders by collaborating with Business Development, Contracts Department, and executive management.
Monitors trends and drives changes to the plan as needed; identifies risks to delivery and drives development of mitigation plans with the project team to be presented to the client.
Ensures adherence to quality control expectations and milestone timelines for delivery of contractually required reports and deliverables.
Prospectively manages client expectations.
Effectively manages project resources (i.e., budget, personnel, and subcontracts).
Supports the culture of the business unit according to Emmes core values.
Identifies and manages change to scope and requests for out of scope activities.
Presents in bid defense meetings in collaboration with Business Development
Leads development study management plans with core project team members.
Identifies and documents lessons learned from study successes and challenges to promote development of best practices.
Models and propagates Emmes' commitment to a culture of quality in all aspects of our deliverables, utilizing a solution based, science driven, value added approach in collaborating with clients.
Supports corporate and departmental initiatives upon request.
Fosters a global perspective amongst the project teams from a depth of understanding of the interdependences of project, teams and timelines.
Delegates tasks according to individual/team strengths on supported global projects.
May supervise GPM team members
Provides leadership for junior GPM staff through mentoring, guiding, and coaching.
Supports recruitment/retention strategies and related initiatives.
Assesses direct report training needs.
Approves timesheets, expense reports, and leave requests.
Collaboratively conducts performance and compensation review activities for direct reports.
Responsible for addressing employee relations issues and resolving problems.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree Scientific discipline. Required
12+ Years demonstrating scientific principles appropriate in managing a clinical research portfolio, including multi-phase research experience in a broad range of indications and client types Required
7-9 years in a pharmaceutical and/or CRO setting, serving in a global Clinical Trial Team Lead or Global Project Management role or equivalent Required
4-6 years supervisory experience in a similar work environment. Required
Demonstrable track record of success delivering complex and high priority clinical trials within agreed time, quality and cost working across multiple therapeutic areas, phases 1 to 4, in a global capacity. High
Demonstrated experience in developing and fostering strong client and internal relationships. High
Thorough understanding of ICH GCP and applicable global regulatory regulations and guidelines. High
Skilled in MS Office Suite of products and strong working knowledge of Clinical Trial Management Systems, electronic Trial Master File, and electronic Data Capture systems and solutions. High
Successful record in managing diverse staff and leading strong teams. Experience in both direct and indirect supervision responsibilities. High
Additional project management certifications such as PMP and training are an asset High
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. High

If you’re looking for a career where your work advances global health
and where scientific excellence meets real-world impact
, join us and be part of something bigger. One Team, One Purpose.

CONNECT WITH US!

Find us on LinkedIn:/the-emmes-group/

Visit our website:https://www.theemmesgroup.com/

jobs.title: Program Manager, Syphilis Free Start
jobs.description:
About Evidence Action

At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.

Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.

Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.

About the SFS Program and Role:

Every year, there are over 200,000 stillbirths and newborn deaths and over 100,000 instances of disability among newborns because of a preventable infection; maternal syphilis. In fact, the infection causes more stillbirths and newborn deaths than pediatric HIV, yet receives only a fraction of the resources.

Through our Syphilis-Free Start (SFS) program, our aim is to close syphilis screening gaps via introduction of HIV/syphilis dual testing and to close treatment gaps by implementing strategies to address context-specific treatment barriers for women who test positive for syphilis. We've already reached mothers across Liberia, Zambia, Cameroon, and Côte d'Ivoire, with new pilots underway in Indonesia and are continuing to scope our programs in additional geographies.

Reporting to our Associate Director, you will lead Evidence Action's work to test what else the SFS model can do. You will shape the design and rigorous assessment of new theories of change for the program, looking at what new health outcomes the model could credibly deliver, new platforms through which maternal syphilis testing and treatment could be delivered, and new geographies and health system contexts where our model might fit. The role combines program design leadership with strong monitoring, evaluation, and data analysis skills, and is accountable for producing clear, evidence-based recommendations on whether and how each new direction should be pursued at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

Theory of Change and Program Model Design

Design testable program models to answer the program's open questions on outcomes, delivery platform, and technology, specifying what would justify scale-up
Develop and pressure-test the theory of change for expanding the program's outcome set beyond syphilis, including the pathway to HIV and hepatitis B impact and the assumptions each pathway depends on
Assess alternative service delivery platforms such as private and faith-based facilities, community-based outreach, and other entry points
Work with the global MLE team and the Data & Learning Manager to define formative research questions, measurement frameworks, and evaluation approaches for each pilot

Pilot Execution & Program Management

Oversee day-to-day pilot implementation, including partner and contract management, rollout, training, and troubleshooting
Adapt management approaches to different delivery models, including pilots run by local implementing partners or contracted firms
Contribute to program planning, workplans, and reporting, and flag issues, timeline risks, or scope changes early to the Associate Director, SFS
Provide program input into baseline and endline design, and support integration of indicators into HMIS and DHIS2 where feasible

Emerging Technology Assessment

Track the antenatal diagnostic landscape and maintain an informed view on which emerging products, including triplex HIV/syphilis/hepatitis B tests and treponemal/non-treponemal test combinations, to determine which merit assessment for program introduction
Assess candidate technologies against the operational realities of program contexts: cost and procurement pathways, regulatory and national guideline requirements, provider workflow and training burden, testing algorithm complexity, and the referral and treatment pathways each result triggers
Design and lead introduction pilots for selected technologies, in partnership with the global MLE team and Ministry counterparts, and produce clear recommendations on whether and how to proceed, provided funding for such activities is secured

Analysis, Recommendations, and Learning

Synthesize pilot findings into clear, decision-oriented assessments of feasibility, effectiveness, and scale-up potential, with an explicit recommendation on each theory of change tested
Support quantitative and qualitative data analysis, in collaboration with the MLE team, using tools such as Stata, R, or Excel
Develop concrete recommendations for program adaptation, including changes to policy, service delivery, testing algorithms, and implementation models
Share learnings across pilot geographies and the SFS portfolio, and translate them for external technical audiences

Country Engagement

Serve as Evidence Action's primary point of contact with Ministries of Health and other stakeholders in pilot geographies
Oversee and manage local implementing partners and contractors to support pilot implementation in-country
Share findings and recommendations with Ministries so that scale-up decisions reflect government priorities

Requirements

A Masters in public health, epidemiology, statistics, public policy, or a related field
Minimum 5-7 years of experience in global health programs, with both program management experience and a monitoring, learning, and evaluation (MLE) background in LMIC contexts
You have designed program models for new interventions or pilots, and defined how to measure them (indicators, data collection, and evaluation approach), not only monitored or evaluated models designed by others.
You have used evidence to make recommendations to continue, adapt, or stop a program
You have experience managing routine data collection and analysis
Strong quantitative skills and data analysis (proficiency in Stata, R, or equivalent preferred)
You have operated as both a program lead and an MLE lead with the ability to shape a program model and rigorously test it
You are able to adapt your communications style for teams at different skill levels and across different cultural contexts internally and externally. and experience producing clear, decision-oriented reports for program and donor audiences
You have the ability to manage complex and interdependent projects and build structured, but flexible, processes
You enjoy building processes from ambiguity and can help the team operate across low resource program contexts and adapt approaches to available infrastructure and systems
French language skills, both spoken and written, is preferred but not required

Location

This role will be based remotely within the United States. You are welcome but not required to work out of Evidence Action's office in Washington, DC. Evidence Action team members work across timezones in the US, Africa, and Asia, and meetings may be scheduled to best capture team needs. This role requires regular international travel (:30%) to Indonesia, Madagascar, and other new geographies, particularly during pilot start-up and data collection periods.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a U.S. employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. for roles based in the U.S.

Benefits

The expected role range for this US position is listed below. We consider multiple factors when determining the base salary for a role, including but not limited to: role scope, program budgets, internal equity, and a candidate's qualifications and/or prior experience.

Note: Pay and benefits will be commensurate with the role specifications, local statutory requirements, and the cost of labor in the markets where we operate.

The expected pay range for this full-time role is $83,900 - 94,0000 per year.

For US based roles, Evidence Action provides comprehensive benefits including international health care, HSA/FSA options, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement plans with a matching component, generous and flexible leave options, as well as other employee perks on a reimbursement basis. For more information visit our careers page or ask our recruiting team!

Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

About Securitas USA

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is a global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology, and risk management across many industries. Our mission is to help make your world a safer place. For 90 years, we’ve built our business on trust, innovation, and international expertise, providing tailored security solutions that combine cutting-edge technology with exceptional service.

Location:
Remote (must reside in the US)

Travel:
Up to 25%

Salary Range:
$110,000–$120,000 annually, depending on location, experience, and skills

What You’ll Do

As a Health & Safety Program Manager, you will drive Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) performance in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll design and manage safety programs tailored to client needs and own both operational performance and risk management outcomes.

You will support the Datacenter Physical Security & Safety program by providing expert EHS guidance, incident management, and program coordination across the region.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Program Management

Support EHS activities in the region, aligning with client expectations and Securitas standards.
Ensure compliance with OSHA and other applicable regulations.
Build strong client relationships and provide structure and direction for the EHS team.
Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.
Perform other duties as needed to support the Datacenter Physical Security & Safety program.

Incident & Risk Management

Lead remote incident management for injuries, from intake through root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Handle EHS escalations, including occasional weekends and holidays.
Provide timely, accurate communication to stakeholders during escalations.
Conduct annual reviews of safety-related documents with stakeholders.

Client Relations & Communication

Develop and deliver presentations in partnership with field operations and subject matter experts.
Present EHS performance, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Maintain a customer service mindset and partner with the client to resolve issues.
Schedule and facilitate client and internal meetings using client meeting tools.

Operational Excellence & Data Management

Coordinate EHS-related projects with training, communications, and project management teams.
Manage EHS databases and reporting; use Power BI and Excel to build and analyze reports and dashboards.
Ensure proper EHS document retention per client and company requirements.

Who You Are

You bring:

A service-first mindset, clear communication, and strong attention to detail.
A solutions-focused approach and the ability to work both independently and in teams.
Comfort in a fast-paced environment with frequent stakeholder interaction and occasional off-hours escalations.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

Certifications

Professional safety certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, or similar) preferred.

Skills And Experience

Must-Have

At least three years of program management experience with Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) programs and OSHA or similar regulatory frameworks.
Experience with Data Center Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) programs.
Strong Power BI and Excel skills for data analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation.
Proven ability to develop and deliver presentations to senior stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident and escalation reporting.
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
Strong relationship-building skills with clients, field operations, and cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in EHS program management within datacenter, technology, or critical infrastructure environments.
Knowledge of datacenter operations, physical security, or related industries.
Experience with remote incident management and multi-site EHS support.
Professional safety certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, or similar).

Why you would want to join the team

Direct impact on the safety and well-being of employees and contractors in a critical datacenter environment.
Regular interaction with high-level client stakeholders and Securitas leadership.
Opportunities to grow within Securitas’ broader Health & Safety and operational leadership structure.
Supportive leadership and a collaborative team focused on continuous improvement and learning.
Exposure to advanced technology environments and complex EHS challenges.
A strong partnership with the client and a culture that values proactive safety and clear communication.

Make an Impact at Securitas USA

Securitas USA employees come from all walks of life, bringing a variety of skills, experiences, and perspectives. United by a shared purpose, we help make the world a safer place. We provide security services to meet the unique needs of our clients to help safeguard their people and assets.

At Securitas USA, our core values are the foundation of everything we do. Represented by the three red dots in our logo, Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness
guide how we serve our clients, support our colleagues, and engage with our communities.

Integrity

We act with honesty, accountability, and professionalism in everything we do, and we foster a culture where transparency, respect, and ethical behavior are expected.

Vigilance

We stay alert, aware, and attentive to our surroundings. Through observing and reporting, our employees help identify potential risks and respond to situations that may impact safety and security.

Helpfulness

We are approachable and service-oriented, whether assisting a client, colleague, or member of the community.

Securitas USA is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodation: Securitas USA is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Application Security
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, Application Security, you will lead the post-sale journey for a portfolio of large enterprise customers, turning their investment in Harness shift-left and runtime security products into measurable business outcomes. You will guide implementations, build adoption, and earn the trust of security and executive leaders along the way.

You are the primary point of contact for your customers and the link between customer, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex security rollouts and helping people succeed with technology, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Deliver customer outcomes

Drive measurable value for enterprise customers from the Harness runtime and shift-left security portfolio.
Own the end-to-end journey: onboarding and implementation, adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness.
Build and run customer success plans that connect product capabilities to each customer's business and security goals, and track progress against them.

Lead complex security programs

Manage multi-workstream implementations, including roadmap, milestones, scope, resourcing, and risk, across Harness and customer teams.
Lead the engagement rhythm: weekly status, clear communication, and proactive risk management. You own the next steps and keep them moving.
Keep project and delivery records clean and current across your portfolio.

Grow adoption and customer health

Watch for early signs of risk, such as slow adoption, stalled integrations, or sponsor changes, and act on them quickly.
Spot opportunities for deeper adoption and bring them to the account team.

Build executive and cross-team relationships

Description

Amazon's Global Road Safety organization is responsible for driving the safety of our on-road operations worldwide. We are a data-driven team that believes world-class safety performance requires world-class measurement. We hold ourselves to the highest standards and are committed to raising the bar through rigorous measurement, continuous learning, and data-driven action.

To that end, Amazon's Global Road Safety (GRS) organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to build and lead our incident management system and the data it produces. This role owns the full incident lifecycle, from initial report and investigation through enrichment with internal and external data sources, with the goal of creating an accurate, governed, and actionable record of safety incidents at a global scale. The data this system produces must be complete, consistent, and structured to power the insights and programs that drive meaningful safety incident reduction across Amazon's on-road operations.

You will build programs and processes that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and enriched with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry consortia, peer disclosures, academic research). You will establish data governance standards that ensure consistency, accuracy, and accountability across geographies and business units. You will apply AI and automation to accelerate incident processing and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity. Partnering with safety, operations, and data science teams, you will ensure that every incident record surfaces the patterns and contributing factors that inform future safety programs. Beyond internal data, you will source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's performance and identify industry best practices that drive measurable improvement.

This role operates globally, requires comfort with ambiguity, and demands the ability to influence senior leaders to act on data-driven findings.

Key job responsibilities

Design and build programs that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and documented across Amazon's global on-road operations, including establishing standards for investigation rigor, consistency, and timeliness.
Develop frameworks that enrich incident records with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry reports).
Establish data governance standards that ensure incident data is consistent, accurate, and accountable across geographies and business units, including clear ownership of data quality at each stage of the incident lifecycle.
Evaluate how AI and automation can accelerate incident processing, pattern detection, and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity.
Define and refine metrics that measure the completeness and actionability of incident data, safety trends, contributing factors, and the effectiveness of incident reduction programs.
Align cross-functional stakeholders (safety, operations, legal, data science, engineering) around shared processes, standards, and priorities for how incident data is collected, used, and acted upon.
Source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's safety performance against peer companies, industry standards, and publicly available safety data.

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Technical Program Managers (TPMs) in the Network Product Development (NPD) organization are responsible for managing the life cycle of significantly complex network products. They own developing processes for product development, leveraging leading-edge technology with significant technical and schedule risks, multiple external and internal dependencies, and ambiguous business strategies. They partner with engineering teams to develop program milestones, identify risks, and create mitigation strategies. They also collaborate with supply chain teams to develop supplier and geographical diversity strategy at component and module levels, product manufacturing scaling plans, and transition plans for new products, balancing technical risks in programs with supply risks.

TPMs understand the business strategies of different suppliers and influence the development of various business models to drive the creation of lowest-cost and highest-availability network products. They communicate effectively, both internally and externally, to bring clarity on goals, and align stakeholders on program status, risks, and plans. They develop a robust ecosystem of Switch, edge computing and delivering racks.

Senior TPMs navigate this complex and ambiguous landscape, leveraging their technical knowledge, leadership skills, and cross-functional collaboration abilities to successfully drive the life cycle of optical programs. They play a crucial role in ensuring that Switches and racks product development aligns with the organization's long-term vision and strategy while maintaining a balance between speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs—setting the mission, objectives, and measurable success criteria while driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver.
Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, align on requirements, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope.
Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing.
Leverage data and metrics to track program health, communicate progress to Directors and VPs through well-structured narratives, and ensure programs stay aligned with organizational goals.
Apply technical judgment to evaluate system designs and proposals, incorporating considerations for scalability, maintainability, and performance while integrating generative AI tools where they can augment productivity and quality.
Understand the AWS networking link deployment process, including the various tools, alarms, and KPIs that define success or failure.
Understand the AWS cloud infrastructure/fabric topology design
Collaborate with the tools and metrics teams to define product roadmaps and timelines, and execute against them
Manage our relationship with our JDM and rack integrators

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and preparing a status update for leadership, then shift into a design review where you question architectural assumptions alongside senior engineers. After lunch, you could facilitate a cross-team alignment session to resolve a dependency that is blocking a critical deliverable. Later in the afternoon, you draft a program narrative that frames a key trade-off decision for VP-level review. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to ambiguous problems and keep multiple workstreams moving toward their goals.

About The Team

Our team is focused on building technology solutions that directly improve the experience for Amazon's customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers, engineers, and business partners work closely together to tackle meaningful challenges at scale. We value clear thinking, thoughtful communication, and a willingness to simplify wherever possible. As we continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to shape program strategy, mentor fellow team members, and help define how we deliver on our most important goals in the years ahead.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business, Private Brand, Recommerce
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon is reinventing how organizations of every size buy, sell, and recover value — and Amazon India is on a fast-growing trajectory across three businesses: Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. That growth depends on one thing: India rapidly adopting the tools, platforms, and AI capabilities being built across the company, rather than rebuilding them. We are hiring a Seattle-based Senior Technical Program Manager to own that mission end to end.

In this high-visibility role, you will be the single owner of capability alignment between India and the global teams that build Amazon's products, spanning Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. Sitting at the interface between India's businesses and the teams that build the roadmaps, you will ensure India is represented when new capabilities are designed, maintain a single view of capability adoption across all three lines of business, sequence the cross-organizational dependencies , and advocate for India's priorities in global planning.

This is a rare front-row seat; You will work hand-in-hand with the teams building Amazon's newest business models and agentic AI products — from enterprise procurement and conversational commerce to intelligent, automated operations — gaining exposure to latest technology and go-to-market approaches before they scale, and shaping how they reach one of Amazon's most important growth markets.

If you excel at influence without authority, thrive across organizational and geographic boundaries, and want a strategic mandate with executive visibility at the leading edge of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the capability-inclusion mechanism: Represent India in global product planning, requirements, and design reviews from the outset — converting today's informal, ad-hoc process into a governed, repeatable intake across all three businesses.

Run a single view of capability adoption: Maintain source of truth for the full portfolio of tracked capabilities across the three businesses, with dependency maps and effort sizing, and represent it in global planning and review forums.

Sequence cross-team dependencies: Untangle the multi-team dependency chains that cause launches to slip, coordinating across engineering, product, finance/compliance, and operations teams.

Negotiate funding and execution ownership for India-specific customization work, including the last-mile localization required to bring global capabilities to market in India.

Advocate for India's priorities in global planning, escalating structural blockers to the right leaders with clear, data-backed cases — particularly where India is deprioritized despite its strategic value.

Establish the baseline and reporting that measure adoption progress and inform how the function scales over time.

Partner deeply with the teams building Amazon's newest products and business models, ensuring India's needs are reflected early and that new capabilities reach the market efficiently.

A day in the life

You start your morning with AI as your co-pilot — using Amazon's internal generative-AI tools to scan overnight changes across the global product roadmaps for all three businesses, summarize what moved, and surface the handful of new capabilities where India isn't yet in the design conversation. What used to take an analyst days, you triage before your first meeting.

Mid-morning, you join a working session with a product team building one of Amazon's newest AI-powered capabilities, aligning India into their next release so the market isn't left to catch up later. You then prepare for the executive review you own — a recurring leadership forum where you present the single view of capability adoption across the three businesses, call out risks and dependencies, and drive decisions with senior leaders on what India needs and when.

In the afternoon, you unblock a stalled dependency: a global capability that needs a market-specific compliance change before India can adopt it. You get the owning teams and India's tech lead aligned on sequencing and funding, turning a multi-quarter stall into a committed plan. Alongside the day-to-day, you're steering the India launch of a multi-million-dollar product — coordinating engineering, finance, and operations across two continents to bring a capability to one of Amazon's most important growth markets.

You close the day the way you opened it — with AI doing the heavy lifting: drafting an escalation, modeling a dependency sequence, and building the data-backed case for why a high-value capability should reach India sooner. You are not just adopting Amazon's AI tools; you are living at the frontier of how they change the way work gets done.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Etch Programs
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

Central Engineering is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development and commercialization of Central Engineering capabilities required by Etch products.

This role has end-to-end program accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning platform, robotics and automation, software, systems integration, and advanced R&D capabilities. The TPM will work across Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions to translate product and chamber requirements into clearly scoped engineering programs and drive those programs from requirements definition through development, system integration, lab readiness, customer introduction, and commercialization.

The TPM is expected to operate as an accountable program owner, not simply as a coordinator between organizations. The role owns program definition and execution across multiple engineering organizations, including scope, priorities, deliverables, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, customer introduction, and Product Development Process execution.

Success requires strong technical judgment, systems thinking, program leadership, and the ability to drive execution across organizations where engineering resources and priorities must be negotiated and aligned.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Execution

Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional technical programs supporting Etch product development and commercialization, from initial requirements and program definition through engineering development, integration, lab validation, customer introduction, and release.
Serve as the single-point accountable owner for Product Development Process execution for assigned Central Engineering programs supporting Etch.
Establish clear program scope, objectives, technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
Drive programs to deliver integrated, working solutions, ensuring individual engineering deliverables come together successfully at the system level rather than managing functional activities independently.
Maintain accountability for program commitments and proactively drive recovery plans when technical, resource, schedule, or integration issues place commitments at risk.

Requirements And Systems Integration

Partner with Etch product and engineering organizations to scope and translate chamber and product requirements into requirements for Central Engineering capabilities, including platform, robotics and automation, software, controls, systems engineering, and advanced R&D technologies.
Drive requirements alignment across product, chamber, platform, software, robotics, and engineering organizations to ensure interfaces, dependencies, and system-level requirements are clearly understood.
Work across multiple technical disciplines to identify integration risks, architecture dependencies, qualification requirements, and gaps that could impact product readiness or customer introduction.
Ensure engineering solutions are developed and integrated to meet the needs of the Etch product roadmap and intended customer use cases.

Portfolio, Priority, and Resource Management

Manage a portfolio of Central Engineering programs and capabilities supporting Etch, maintaining visibility across program health, engineering resources, technical maturity, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments.
Lead the scoping and prioritization of new program requests and determine the engineering capabilities, resources, and organizations required for execution.
Negotiate and align priorities between Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions when resource capacity, technical dependencies, schedules, or competing priorities require trade-offs.
Identify portfolio-level resource constraints and cross-program dependencies early and drive decisions with appropriate engineering and product leadership.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into program health, resource needs, critical risks, decision points, and recovery actions.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Work across Product and Engineering disciplines to establish clear ownership and drive teams toward a common technical and program outcome.
Lead cross-functional execution across organizations responsible for platform, robotics, automation, software, controls, systems integration, and advanced engineering technologies.
Drive decisions across organizational boundaries and hold teams accountable for agreed deliverables, timelines, and technical outcomes.
Influence without direct authority by establishing clear requirements, data-driven priorities, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
Resolve ambiguity around scope, ownership, priorities, interfaces, resources, and execution responsibility before those gaps affect program delivery.

Risk and Customer Introduction

Own identification and management of technical, integration, resource, schedule, qualification, and customer-introduction risks across assigned programs.
Establish mitigation and recovery plans for critical program risks and escalate decisions when cross-organizational alignment or leadership intervention is required.
Coordinate readiness across engineering teams for lab integration, system qualification, product release, and customer introduction.
Ensure issues discovered during system integration or customer introduction are driven to root cause, corrective action, ownership, and closure.

Qualifications

Required

BS or MS degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in high-tech product development, systems engineering, systems integration, engineering program management, or technical program management.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary engineering programs involving multiple engineering organizations and technical dependencies.
Strong understanding of structured product development processes and experience driving programs from requirements through development, integration, qualification, and release.
Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, and technical integration across matrixed organizations.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand interactions between hardware, software, automation, controls, and product-level requirements.
Demonstrated ability to negotiate priorities and drive decisions and execution without direct authority.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to technical and business leadership.

Preferred

Experience in semiconductor capital equipment or semiconductor manufacturing technology.
Experience supporting complex semiconductor equipment development involving process chambers, platforms, robotics and automation, controls, embedded or application software, and system integration.
Experience with New Product Development, Product Development Process, NPI, system qualification, and customer introduction.
Familiarity with Etch equipment and technologies such as process chambers, vacuum systems, RF/plasma systems, gas delivery, automation, robotics, controls, and related platform technologies.
Experience driving engineering execution across product engineering, systems engineering, software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, service, and business organizations.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is a technically credible program leader and systems thinker who can operate across both product and engineering organizations.

This person does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every technical discipline, but must be able to understand how the pieces come together at the system level, challenge assumptions, expose gaps and dependencies, and drive engineering organizations toward an integrated solution.

The ideal candidate can take an initially ambiguous product or chamber requirement and turn it into a well-defined technical program with clear requirements, architecture dependencies, engineering ownership, resources, priorities, milestones, risks, and customer deliverables, and then remain accountable until the solution is working and successfully introduced.

Why This Role Matters

Etch products increasingly depend on capabilities that span multiple Central Engineering organizations and technical disciplines. Successful execution requires more than coordination of individual engineering activities. It requires system-level ownership of how those capabilities are scoped, prioritized, developed, integrated, qualified, and delivered as a working solution.

The Technical Program Manager provides that ownership.

By managing both individual programs and the broader portfolio of Central Engineering commitments supporting Etch, this role will improve requirements clarity, resource and priority alignment, engineering integration, risk management, Product Development Process discipline, customer readiness, and predictability of execution.

Yes, 10% of the Time

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

Job Description

The Senior QA/DV Program Manager a highly skilled and driven Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution, delivery, and quality assurance of multiple ASIC SOC hardware and BMC software solutions portfolios. In this role, you will lead the program management for our End-to-End Quality Assurance (QA) team, and drive the program execution for our complex SOC Design Verification projects (DV).

You will have the opportunity to work closely with various engineering teams, from HW/SW design, verification, validation and system integration.

Multi-Project Lifecycle Ownership: Track multiple parallel ASIC SOC projects from pre-silicon phases through to final deployment.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate schedules and dependencies between QA, Software, Architecture, Design, and DV teams.
Risk Mitigation & Resolution: Identify technical and schedule bottlenecks early to develop clear mitigation plans.
Metrics & Reporting: Report key execution metrics and milestone readiness regularly to engineering leadership.

System-Level QA Strategy: Oversee the testing schedule for full server systems and BMC boards hosting the SOC.
Bug Tracking & Resolution: Drive the end-to-end triaging, tracking, and closure of system-level defects with engineering teams.
Hardware/Software Co-Verification: Manage program dependencies for QA teams validating firmware, security layers, and Linux OS.
Automation & Infrastructure: Track the deployment of automated test regressions running on physical server infrastructure.

DV Program Focus

Milestone Tracking & Delivery: Drive schedule adherence for block-level, subsystem, and full-chip verification milestones.
Bug Lifecycle Management: Monitor pre-silicon bug burn-down rates and prioritize critical fixes to keep tape-out schedules on track.
Scope Tracking: Coordinate with DV team leads to ensure timelines account for coverage all critical components.
Emulation & Pre-Silicon Planning: Drive reviews, schedule and track dependencies for emulation and FPGA development, and coordinate with design, DV and software teams.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience: 7+ years as a Technical Program Manager managing complex silicon or system-level validation programs.
Systems QA Expertise: Strong understanding of system-level QA frameworks, automated test setups, and server or BMC testing.
Silicon Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with multi-CPU SOC architectures, hardware security, and interfaces like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet.

Tools & Methodologies: Proven proficiency with project management tools like Jira and standard hardware/software release processes.

Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in EE, CE, CS, or a technical MBA.
AI Productivity Tools: Proficiency using AI-based tools for program management optimization, action-item tracking, and automated meeting minutes.
BMC & Server Ecosystem: Direct experience with Baseboard Management Controllers, embedded Linux, or IPMI/Redfish protocols.
Security Frameworks: Understanding of hardware Root-of-Trust, cryptographic accelerators, and secure boot architectures.

You will translate business, risk and regulatory objectives into cybersecurity controls, governance frameworks and risk operating models, remain directly involved in critical strategic decisions, and guide teams from assessment through implementation alongside the practice's Data, Infrastructure, Identity, Security Operations and Application Security capabilities. You will also shape solutions during pursuits and help build repeatable delivery assets.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Manager on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for:

Leading AI cybersecurity strategy assessments, governance workshops, and risk operating model design for clients adopting generative artificial intelligence and agentic systems.
Translating business objectives, regulatory obligations, and risk appetite into AI governance frameworks, risk taxonomies, and control operating models.
Advising clients on AI security strategy decisions while reviewing governance artifacts, policy documents, and risk assessments developed by engagement teams.
Managing engagement scope, teams, milestones, quality, and client expectations across strategy-led AI security programs.
Coordinating with Data, Infrastructure, Identity, Application Security, and Security Operations leaders to help translate strategic recommendations into implementable technical requirements, and technical considerations into strategic decisions.
Shaping solutions during pursuits through workshops, executive briefings, proposals, estimates, and delivery plans, while developing reusable cyber strategy assets including security controls, governance frameworks, maturity models, risk taxonomies, and playbooks, and coaching practitioners on advisory quality.

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.
