new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Application Security
new_jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About The Role

As a Senior Program Manager, Application Security, you will lead the post-sale journey for a portfolio of large enterprise customers, turning their investment in Harness shift-left and runtime security products into measurable business outcomes. You will guide implementations, build adoption, and earn the trust of security and executive leaders along the way.

You are the primary point of contact for your customers and the link between customer, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex security rollouts and helping people succeed with technology, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Deliver customer outcomes

Drive measurable value for enterprise customers from the Harness runtime and shift-left security portfolio.
Own the end-to-end journey: onboarding and implementation, adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness.
Build and run customer success plans that connect product capabilities to each customer's business and security goals, and track progress against them.

Lead complex security programs

Manage multi-workstream implementations, including roadmap, milestones, scope, resourcing, and risk, across Harness and customer teams.
Lead the engagement rhythm: weekly status, clear communication, and proactive risk management. You own the next steps and keep them moving.
Keep project and delivery records clean and current across your portfolio.

Grow adoption and customer health

Watch for early signs of risk, such as slow adoption, stalled integrations, or sponsor changes, and act on them quickly.
Spot opportunities for deeper adoption and bring them to the account team.

Build executive and cross-team relationships

Build and sustain trusted relationships with customer executives, including CISOs and security and engineering leaders.
Plan and lead quarterly executive business reviews that show ROI, risk reduction, and the road ahead.
Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support. Carry customer feedback to Product, and bring the right people together when an issue needs attention.

Stay close to the technology

Learn the products hands-on and run product demos and workshops, in plain language that works for both executives and practitioners.

What You Bring

7+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Program Management, or Professional Services in a SaaS environment, including experience with security products or programs.
A track record of leading large, multi-workstream security or software implementations from start to finish, with results you can point to.
Experience driving adoption and customer outcomes in complex, fast-moving technical environments.
Working knowledge of modern security practices, such as secure software development, CI/CD, runtime security and vulnerability management.
Comfort building relationships with both executives and hands-on technical teams, along with strong analytical and communication skills.
Familiarity with CRM, customer success, and project tools such as Salesforce, Gainsight, and Jira.
A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

You don't need all of these. If you meet most of the requirements above and are excited about the work, we'd like to hear from you.

A program management or security certification, such as PMP, CISSP, or CSSLP.
Familiarity with “Forward-Deployed-Engineer” (FDE) and “Echo” delivery motion.
Hands-on exposure to application or API security, DevSecOps, or cloud-native tooling.
Experience with customers in regulated industries, such as financial services or healthcare.
Experience running product demos or technical workshops.

What Success Looks Like

Customers reach their agreed time-to-value milestones on schedule.
Product adoption and customer health scores improve across your portfolio.
Executive sponsors can clearly describe the security outcomes they have gained.
Accounts renew and grow with no surprises.
Projects, plans, and status updates are accurate and current.

Harness In The News

Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

Program Manager, Client Health
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Executive Program Manager is a strategic, cross-functional leader responsible for driving programs, business initiatives, and organizational priorities at Marvel Marketers. Taking direction directly from the CEO, this role translates executive vision into actionable plans, coordinates execution across the business, and ensures high-priority initiatives are delivered with accountability, efficiency, and operational excellence.

As a key member of Marvel Marketers’ Program Management Center of Excellence (CoE), the Executive Program Manager helps establish consistent program management practices, improve cross-functional collaboration, and strengthen the organization's ability to execute strategic initiatives. This individual works closely with the CEO and leadership team to identify priorities, resolve challenges, manage dependencies, and maintain visibility into progress and outcomes.

The primary focus is client-facing program execution, including the ability to participate in and independently lead client discussions, assess client sentiment and temperament, and represent Marvel Marketers professionally. This role requires the confidence and judgment to manage certain client meetings independently, allowing for greater autonomy as needed, while supporting broader client-related initiatives. Strong internal program management skills are also essential to ensure effective coordination and execution across internal teams.

The Executive Program Manager will provide flexible people leadership across the organization, with direct management responsibility for team members assigned to specific programs or initiatives. This includes establishing clear expectations, coordinating resources, coaching team members, and ensuring accountability for delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, executive presence, strong program management capabilities, and effective people leadership. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and moving seamlessly between executive-level planning and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Partnership & Strategic Program Leadership

Partner directly with the CEO to translate Marvel Marketers’ strategic objectives and business priorities into actionable programs, plans, and measurable outcomes.
Lead internal strategic initiatives and special projects on behalf of the CEO, ensuring clear ownership, alignment, and timely execution.
Translate executive discussions and decisions into defined next steps, deliverables, timelines, and accountability across teams.
Identify organizational challenges, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement; develop recommendations and drive solutions through implementation.
Provide regular updates to the CEO and leadership team on program progress, risks, resource requirements, decisions, and outcomes.
Conduct research and synthesize complex information into executive briefings, presentations, and decision-support materials.
Exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential business, financial, personnel, and strategic information.
Apply strong mathematical, quantitative, and analytical skills to evaluate financial information, analyze program performance, identify variances, and support data-driven decision-making.

Internal Program & Project Management

Lead cross-functional programs and projects that support Marvel Marketers’ business objectives, operational priorities, and organizational growth.
Manage initiatives from initial scoping and planning through execution, delivery, closeout, and retrospective.
Develop program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, and success metrics.
Coordinate workstreams, dependencies, and priorities across departments to ensure initiatives remain on track.
Establish appropriate governance, communication plans, documentation, and tracking mechanisms to support effective execution.
Proactively identify risks, roadblocks, and competing priorities, developing mitigation strategies and escalating issues with recommended solutions.
Monitor program outcomes and use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to improve future execution.

Client Health & Relationship Management

Monitor client health, engagement, and relationship strength to proactively identify risks, address concerns, and support long-term client retention.
Establish and maintain visibility into client priorities, satisfaction, engagement trends, and overall account health using relevant data, feedback, and stakeholder insights.
Identify early warning signs of client dissatisfaction, misalignment, disengagement, or delivery challenges; coordinate cross-functional action plans to resolve issues and mitigate risk.
Partner with internal teams and client-facing stakeholders to ensure client needs, expectations, and priorities are understood and reflected in program execution and service delivery.
Lead or support client-facing discussions, account reviews, and strategic check-ins as needed to assess progress, gather feedback, align on priorities, and strengthen client partnerships.
Track client health indicators, document key risks and action items, and communicate material account developments and recommended interventions to leadership.
Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve the client experience, and support account growth or expanded services in alignment with client needs and company priorities.
Handle sensitive client information with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment, ensuring appropriate confidentiality and use of client insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a central point of coordination for internal programs involving multiple departments, leaders, and stakeholders.
Build strong working relationships across the organization to foster collaboration, alignment, and accountability.
Facilitate planning sessions, leadership meetings, and working sessions that drive decisions and progress.
Clarify roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and expectations across teams.
Communicate program updates, decisions, changes, and priorities clearly to stakeholders at all levels.

People Leadership & Resource Coordination

Description

Amazon's Global Road Safety organization is responsible for driving the safety of our on-road operations worldwide. We are a data-driven team that believes world-class safety performance requires world-class measurement. We hold ourselves to the highest standards and are committed to raising the bar through rigorous measurement, continuous learning, and data-driven action.

To that end, Amazon's Global Road Safety (GRS) organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to build and lead our incident management system and the data it produces. This role owns the full incident lifecycle, from initial report and investigation through enrichment with internal and external data sources, with the goal of creating an accurate, governed, and actionable record of safety incidents at a global scale. The data this system produces must be complete, consistent, and structured to power the insights and programs that drive meaningful safety incident reduction across Amazon's on-road operations.

You will build programs and processes that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and enriched with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry consortia, peer disclosures, academic research). You will establish data governance standards that ensure consistency, accuracy, and accountability across geographies and business units. You will apply AI and automation to accelerate incident processing and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity. Partnering with safety, operations, and data science teams, you will ensure that every incident record surfaces the patterns and contributing factors that inform future safety programs. Beyond internal data, you will source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's performance and identify industry best practices that drive measurable improvement.

This role operates globally, requires comfort with ambiguity, and demands the ability to influence senior leaders to act on data-driven findings.

Key job responsibilities

Design and build programs that improve how safety incidents are reported, investigated, and documented across Amazon's global on-road operations, including establishing standards for investigation rigor, consistency, and timeliness.
Develop frameworks that enrich incident records with supplemental data from internal sources (fleet telematics, driver training records, operational and route metadata) and external sources (police crash reports, insurance claims data, government statistics, industry reports).
Establish data governance standards that ensure incident data is consistent, accurate, and accountable across geographies and business units, including clear ownership of data quality at each stage of the incident lifecycle.
Evaluate how AI and automation can accelerate incident processing, pattern detection, and analysis at scale, while keeping safety professionals in the loop to validate findings and ensure data integrity.
Define and refine metrics that measure the completeness and actionability of incident data, safety trends, contributing factors, and the effectiveness of incident reduction programs.
Align cross-functional stakeholders (safety, operations, legal, data science, engineering) around shared processes, standards, and priorities for how incident data is collected, used, and acted upon.
Source and normalize external benchmarks to contextualize Amazon's safety performance against peer companies, industry standards, and publicly available safety data.

About The Role

The role will be responsible for the successful execution of Short-Range Device (SRD) connectivity programs (WiFi, Bluetooth/BLE, V2X, UWB) within Harman Automotive covering both Intelligent Cockpit and Connectivity SBU programs.
The Technical Program Manager leads cross-functional and international teams to deliver hardware-centric connectivity platforms with integrated software, ensuring delivery across development, validation, industrialization, and homologation.
This role operates with high visibility across the Automotive division, supporting and delivering solutions into both Connectivity and IC SBUs. As such, the position requires strong coordination across multiple product lines, platform teams, and business units to ensure alignment on technical solutions, program timing, and customer deliverables.
The role demands strong execution rigor, the ability to manage complex dependencies across hardware and software domains, and effective stakeholder management at program and organizational levels. This role will play a key role in ensuring seamless integration of SRD core assets into broader vehicle platforms, balancing customer expectations, internal priorities, and supplier deliverables.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Network Product Development
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Technical Program Managers (TPMs) in the Network Product Development (NPD) organization are responsible for managing the life cycle of significantly complex network products. They own developing processes for product development, leveraging leading-edge technology with significant technical and schedule risks, multiple external and internal dependencies, and ambiguous business strategies. They partner with engineering teams to develop program milestones, identify risks, and create mitigation strategies. They also collaborate with supply chain teams to develop supplier and geographical diversity strategy at component and module levels, product manufacturing scaling plans, and transition plans for new products, balancing technical risks in programs with supply risks.

TPMs understand the business strategies of different suppliers and influence the development of various business models to drive the creation of lowest-cost and highest-availability network products. They communicate effectively, both internally and externally, to bring clarity on goals, and align stakeholders on program status, risks, and plans. They develop a robust ecosystem of Switch, edge computing and delivering racks.

Senior TPMs navigate this complex and ambiguous landscape, leveraging their technical knowledge, leadership skills, and cross-functional collaboration abilities to successfully drive the life cycle of optical programs. They play a crucial role in ensuring that Switches and racks product development aligns with the organization's long-term vision and strategy while maintaining a balance between speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs—setting the mission, objectives, and measurable success criteria while driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver.
Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, align on requirements, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope.
Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing.
Leverage data and metrics to track program health, communicate progress to Directors and VPs through well-structured narratives, and ensure programs stay aligned with organizational goals.
Apply technical judgment to evaluate system designs and proposals, incorporating considerations for scalability, maintainability, and performance while integrating generative AI tools where they can augment productivity and quality.
Understand the AWS networking link deployment process, including the various tools, alarms, and KPIs that define success or failure.
Understand the AWS cloud infrastructure/fabric topology design
Collaborate with the tools and metrics teams to define product roadmaps and timelines, and execute against them
Manage our relationship with our JDM and rack integrators

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and preparing a status update for leadership, then shift into a design review where you question architectural assumptions alongside senior engineers. After lunch, you could facilitate a cross-team alignment session to resolve a dependency that is blocking a critical deliverable. Later in the afternoon, you draft a program narrative that frames a key trade-off decision for VP-level review. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to ambiguous problems and keep multiple workstreams moving toward their goals.

About The Team

Our team is focused on building technology solutions that directly improve the experience for Amazon's customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers, engineers, and business partners work closely together to tackle meaningful challenges at scale. We value clear thinking, thoughtful communication, and a willingness to simplify wherever possible. As we continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to shape program strategy, mentor fellow team members, and help define how we deliver on our most important goals in the years ahead.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

We are hiring a Seattle-based Senior Technical Program Manager to own that mission end to end.

In this high-visibility role, you will be the single owner of capability alignment between India and the global teams that build Amazon's products, spanning Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. Sitting at the interface between India's businesses and the teams that build the roadmaps, you will ensure India is represented when new capabilities are designed, maintain a single view of capability adoption across all three lines of business, sequence the cross-organizational dependencies , and advocate for India's priorities in global planning.

This is a rare front-row seat; You will work hand-in-hand with the teams building Amazon's newest business models and agentic AI products — from enterprise procurement and conversational commerce to intelligent, automated operations — gaining exposure to latest technology and go-to-market approaches before they scale, and shaping how they reach one of Amazon's most important growth markets.

If you excel at influence without authority, thrive across organizational and geographic boundaries, and want a strategic mandate with executive visibility at the leading edge of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the capability-inclusion mechanism: Represent India in global product planning, requirements, and design reviews from the outset — converting today's informal, ad-hoc process into a governed, repeatable intake across all three businesses.

Run a single view of capability adoption: Maintain source of truth for the full portfolio of tracked capabilities across the three businesses, with dependency maps and effort sizing, and represent it in global planning and review forums.

Sequence cross-team dependencies: Untangle the multi-team dependency chains that cause launches to slip, coordinating across engineering, product, finance/compliance, and operations teams.

Negotiate funding and execution ownership for India-specific customization work, including the last-mile localization required to bring global capabilities to market in India.

Advocate for India's priorities in global planning, escalating structural blockers to the right leaders with clear, data-backed cases — particularly where India is deprioritized despite its strategic value.

Establish the baseline and reporting that measure adoption progress and inform how the function scales over time.

Partner deeply with the teams building Amazon's newest products and business models, ensuring India's needs are reflected early and that new capabilities reach the market efficiently.

A day in the life

You start your morning with AI as your co-pilot — using Amazon's internal generative-AI tools to scan overnight changes across the global product roadmaps for all three businesses, summarize what moved, and surface the handful of new capabilities where India isn't yet in the design conversation. What used to take an analyst days, you triage before your first meeting.

Mid-morning, you join a working session with a product team building one of Amazon's newest AI-powered capabilities, aligning India into their next release so the market isn't left to catch up later. You then prepare for the executive review you own — a recurring leadership forum where you present the single view of capability adoption across the three businesses, call out risks and dependencies, and drive decisions with senior leaders on what India needs and when.

In the afternoon, you unblock a stalled dependency: a global capability that needs a market-specific compliance change before India can adopt it. You get the owning teams and India's tech lead aligned on sequencing and funding, turning a multi-quarter stall into a committed plan. Alongside the day-to-day, you're steering the India launch of a multi-million-dollar product — coordinating engineering, finance, and operations across two continents to bring a capability to one of Amazon's most important growth markets.

You close the day the way you opened it — with AI doing the heavy lifting: drafting an escalation, modeling a dependency sequence, and building the data-backed case for why a high-value capability should reach India sooner. You are not just adopting Amazon's AI tools; you are living at the frontier of how they change the way work gets done.

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Role Overview

Central Engineering is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the development and commercialization of Central Engineering capabilities required by Etch products.

This role has end-to-end program accountability for complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning platform, robotics and automation, software, systems integration, and advanced R&D capabilities. The TPM will work across Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions to translate product and chamber requirements into clearly scoped engineering programs and drive those programs from requirements definition through development, system integration, lab readiness, customer introduction, and commercialization.

The TPM is expected to operate as an accountable program owner, not simply as a coordinator between organizations. The role owns program definition and execution across multiple engineering organizations, including scope, priorities, deliverables, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, customer introduction, and Product Development Process execution.

Success requires strong technical judgment, systems thinking, program leadership, and the ability to drive execution across organizations where engineering resources and priorities must be negotiated and aligned.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Execution

Own end-to-end execution of cross-functional technical programs supporting Etch product development and commercialization, from initial requirements and program definition through engineering development, integration, lab validation, customer introduction, and release.
Serve as the single-point accountable owner for Product Development Process execution for assigned Central Engineering programs supporting Etch.
Establish clear program scope, objectives, technical requirements, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
Drive programs to deliver integrated, working solutions, ensuring individual engineering deliverables come together successfully at the system level rather than managing functional activities independently.
Maintain accountability for program commitments and proactively drive recovery plans when technical, resource, schedule, or integration issues place commitments at risk.

Requirements And Systems Integration

Partner with Etch product and engineering organizations to scope and translate chamber and product requirements into requirements for Central Engineering capabilities, including platform, robotics and automation, software, controls, systems engineering, and advanced R&D technologies.
Drive requirements alignment across product, chamber, platform, software, robotics, and engineering organizations to ensure interfaces, dependencies, and system-level requirements are clearly understood.
Work across multiple technical disciplines to identify integration risks, architecture dependencies, qualification requirements, and gaps that could impact product readiness or customer introduction.
Ensure engineering solutions are developed and integrated to meet the needs of the Etch product roadmap and intended customer use cases.

Portfolio, Priority, and Resource Management

Manage a portfolio of Central Engineering programs and capabilities supporting Etch, maintaining visibility across program health, engineering resources, technical maturity, milestones, dependencies, risks, and customer commitments.
Lead the scoping and prioritization of new program requests and determine the engineering capabilities, resources, and organizations required for execution.
Negotiate and align priorities between Etch product groups and Central Engineering functions when resource capacity, technical dependencies, schedules, or competing priorities require trade-offs.
Identify portfolio-level resource constraints and cross-program dependencies early and drive decisions with appropriate engineering and product leadership.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into program health, resource needs, critical risks, decision points, and recovery actions.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Work across Product and Engineering disciplines to establish clear ownership and drive teams toward a common technical and program outcome.
Lead cross-functional execution across organizations responsible for platform, robotics, automation, software, controls, systems integration, and advanced engineering technologies.
Drive decisions across organizational boundaries and hold teams accountable for agreed deliverables, timelines, and technical outcomes.
Influence without direct authority by establishing clear requirements, data-driven priorities, decision frameworks, and escalation paths.
Resolve ambiguity around scope, ownership, priorities, interfaces, resources, and execution responsibility before those gaps affect program delivery.

Risk and Customer Introduction

Own identification and management of technical, integration, resource, schedule, qualification, and customer-introduction risks across assigned programs.
Establish mitigation and recovery plans for critical program risks and escalate decisions when cross-organizational alignment or leadership intervention is required.
Coordinate readiness across engineering teams for lab integration, system qualification, product release, and customer introduction.
Ensure issues discovered during system integration or customer introduction are driven to root cause, corrective action, ownership, and closure.

Qualifications

Required

BS or MS degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in high-tech product development, systems engineering, systems integration, engineering program management, or technical program management.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary engineering programs involving multiple engineering organizations and technical dependencies.
Strong understanding of structured product development processes and experience driving programs from requirements through development, integration, qualification, and release.
Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, and technical integration across matrixed organizations.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand interactions between hardware, software, automation, controls, and product-level requirements.
Demonstrated ability to negotiate priorities and drive decisions and execution without direct authority.
Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to technical and business leadership.

Preferred

Experience in semiconductor capital equipment or semiconductor manufacturing technology.
Experience supporting complex semiconductor equipment development involving process chambers, platforms, robotics and automation, controls, embedded or application software, and system integration.
Experience with New Product Development, Product Development Process, NPI, system qualification, and customer introduction.
Familiarity with Etch equipment and technologies such as process chambers, vacuum systems, RF/plasma systems, gas delivery, automation, robotics, controls, and related platform technologies.
Experience driving engineering execution across product engineering, systems engineering, software, hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, service, and business organizations.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is a technically credible program leader and systems thinker who can operate across both product and engineering organizations.

This person does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every technical discipline, but must be able to understand how the pieces come together at the system level, challenge assumptions, expose gaps and dependencies, and drive engineering organizations toward an integrated solution.

The ideal candidate can take an initially ambiguous product or chamber requirement and turn it into a well-defined technical program with clear requirements, architecture dependencies, engineering ownership, resources, priorities, milestones, risks, and customer deliverables, and then remain accountable until the solution is working and successfully introduced.

Why This Role Matters

Etch products increasingly depend on capabilities that span multiple Central Engineering organizations and technical disciplines. Successful execution requires more than coordination of individual engineering activities. It requires system-level ownership of how those capabilities are scoped, prioritized, developed, integrated, qualified, and delivered as a working solution.

The Technical Program Manager provides that ownership.

By managing both individual programs and the broader portfolio of Central Engineering commitments supporting Etch, this role will improve requirements clarity, resource and priority alignment, engineering integration, risk management, Product Development Process discipline, customer readiness, and predictability of execution.

About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

Job Description

The Senior QA/DV Program Manager a highly skilled and driven Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution, delivery, and quality assurance of multiple ASIC SOC hardware and BMC software solutions portfolios. In this role, you will lead the program management for our End-to-End Quality Assurance (QA) team, and drive the program execution for our complex SOC Design Verification projects (DV).

You will have the opportunity to work closely with various engineering teams, from HW/SW design, verification, validation and system integration.

Program Management & Execution

Multi-Project Lifecycle Ownership: Track multiple parallel ASIC SOC projects from pre-silicon phases through to final deployment.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate schedules and dependencies between QA, Software, Architecture, Design, and DV teams.
Risk Mitigation & Resolution: Identify technical and schedule bottlenecks early to develop clear mitigation plans.
Metrics & Reporting: Report key execution metrics and milestone readiness regularly to engineering leadership.

QA Program Focus

System-Level QA Strategy: Oversee the testing schedule for full server systems and BMC boards hosting the SOC.
Bug Tracking & Resolution: Drive the end-to-end triaging, tracking, and closure of system-level defects with engineering teams.
Hardware/Software Co-Verification: Manage program dependencies for QA teams validating firmware, security layers, and Linux OS.
Automation & Infrastructure: Track the deployment of automated test regressions running on physical server infrastructure.

DV Program Focus

Milestone Tracking & Delivery: Drive schedule adherence for block-level, subsystem, and full-chip verification milestones.
Bug Lifecycle Management: Monitor pre-silicon bug burn-down rates and prioritize critical fixes to keep tape-out schedules on track.
Scope Tracking: Coordinate with DV team leads to ensure timelines account for coverage all critical components.
Emulation & Pre-Silicon Planning: Drive reviews, schedule and track dependencies for emulation and FPGA development, and coordinate with design, DV and software teams.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience: 7+ years as a Technical Program Manager managing complex silicon or system-level validation programs.
Systems QA Expertise: Strong understanding of system-level QA frameworks, automated test setups, and server or BMC testing.
Silicon Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with multi-CPU SOC architectures, hardware security, and interfaces like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet.
Verification Fundamentals: Basic grasp of pre-silicon Design Verification concepts, coverage metrics, and bug-tracking lifecycles.
Tools & Methodologies: Proven proficiency with project management tools like Jira and standard hardware/software release processes.
Preferred qualifications:

Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in EE, CE, CS, or a technical MBA.
AI Productivity Tools: Proficiency using AI-based tools for program management optimization, action-item tracking, and automated meeting minutes.
BMC & Server Ecosystem: Direct experience with Baseboard Management Controllers, embedded Linux, or IPMI/Redfish protocols.
Security Frameworks: Understanding of hardware Root-of-Trust, cryptographic accelerators, and secure boot architectures.

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

have extensive expertise in security risk management, including conducting security risk assessments and using risk management software.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Transformation Manager / Technical Program Manager to lead complex global transformation programs. The main focus is coordinating the decommissioning of legacy systems in an international IT environment.

The ideal candidate is an expert in end-to-end program management. They can turn IT objectives into clear technology roadmaps that teams can deliver, covering legacy system retirement, enterprise system integration and the move to target platforms. They work closely with architects, developers, application owners and infrastructure teams.

The role calls for strong cross-functional leadership, strategic stakeholder management, and a solid background in Agile and Kanban delivery. It also requires experience leading globally distributed teams and giving executive-level governance and reporting.

Responsibilities:

Transformation & Technology Roadmap Ownership

Turn IT objectives and target architecture goals into clear, prioritized technology roadmaps and delivery plans.
Lead complex, global transformation programs from start to finish, from initiation and planning through execution, transition and closure.
Define program scope, milestones, dependencies and success metrics, and keep them aligned with IT strategy and business needs.
Manage program risks, issues and dependencies across several workstreams and handle them proactively.
Drive change management so new platforms and ways of working are adopted successfully.

Enterprise System Integration & Technical Delivery

Plan and coordinate enterprise system integration across several platforms, applications and regions.
Work closely with architects and developers to make sure solutions are technically sound, scalable and in line with the target architecture.
Turn IT requirements into technical deliverables, and make sure technical constraints are understood at management level.
Oversee release planning, cutover activities and handovers to operations.

Legacy System Decommissioning

Coordinate the full decommissioning of legacy applications, systems and infrastructure, from start to finish.
Build and maintain the inventory of legacy systems, including dependency mapping, interfaces, data flows and contracts.
Define the order and waves of decommissioning, and align them with migration timelines and business continuity needs.
Coordinate data migration, archiving and retention with application owners, data owners and Compliance.
Make sure security, regulatory and audit requirements are met before systems are switched off.
Manage the controlled shutdown of systems, licenses, infrastructure and support contracts, and track the cost savings realized.
Keep decommissioning status, risks and progress visible through Jira, ServiceNow and ADO.

Agile Delivery & Ways of Working

Run delivery using Agile and Kanban methods, including backlog management, flow optimization and continuous improvement.
Set up and maintain Jira dashboards, boards and roadmaps to give clear visibility of progress, capacity and blockers.
Run Agile ceremonies and Kanban practices, such as WIP limits and flow metrics, across distributed teams.
Encourage a results-driven, collaborative and transparent delivery culture.

Stakeholder Management & Executive Governance

Build strong relationships with senior and executive stakeholders across IT, business, application owners and vendors.
Set up and run program governance structures, including steering committees, decision logs and escalation paths.
Prepare clear, concise executive-level status reports, dashboards and presentations, including decommissioning progress and cost savings.
Manage expectations, negotiate priorities and help stakeholders reach decisions when their interests conflict.

Global Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

Lead and motivate globally distributed, cross-functional teams across different time zones and cultures.
Coordinate work between internal teams, infrastructure teams, external partners and service providers.
Make sure roles, responsibilities and accountabilities are clear across the program.
Mentor team members and promote best practices in program and delivery management.

Job Requirements

5-7 years of experience in program management, technical program management or transformation management in an international IT environment.
Proven experience coordinating legacy system decommissioning, including dependency analysis, data migration and archiving, and switching systems off.
Proven ability to turn IT objectives into technology roadmaps that teams can deliver.
Track record of delivering complex, global transformation programs and enterprise system integrations from start to finish.
Strong expertise in Agile delivery; hands-on Kanban experience is a strong plus.
Experience working closely with architects and developers on technical solution delivery.
Proven experience managing globally distributed, cross-functional teams.
Strong ability to give executive-level governance, reporting and communication.
Advanced Jira skills, especially dashboards, boards and roadmaps.

The Protective Intelligence Manager leads the protective intelligence function in support of executive protection, employee safety, travel risk management, event security, and broader corporate security objectives. The role is responsible for managing personnel, intelligence processes, priorities, and deliverables; overseeing the collection, analysis, production, and dissemination of actionable intelligence; and ensuring intelligence is timely, relevant, legally compliant, and aligned with client and organizational requirements. This position is Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 5pm.

new_jobs.description:
호주 시드니 오피스 현지 근무 포지션입니다. This role is based in Sydney, Australia.

About Toss

Toss is South Korea's leading financial super app, trusted by over 20 million users and backed by a fully licensed financial group. Guided by our mission to remove financial friction and redesign financial services from the ground up, Toss continues to transform the finance industry through innovation and simplicity.
As Toss expands into Australia, Toss AU is establishing its regulated presence as a remittance service provider registered with the Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre (AUSTRAC), as one of the key hubs of Toss's global expansion. This role contributes to building the AML/CTF (Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing) operational foundation of Toss AU from an early stage of its market entry.

About The Role

The AML/CTF Operations Analyst reports to the Toss AU AML/CTF Compliance Officer and takes ownership of the day to day AML/CTF operations of Toss AU. The role covers customer due diligence (KYC/CDD/ECDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) screening, and Suspicious Matter Report (SMR) support activities, handling alerts, conducting investigations, and documenting outcomes to manage operational risk.
This is not a routine processing role. You are expected to analyse customer profiles and transaction patterns comprehensively, apply risk-based judgment, and document your findings in clear, structured reports. You will work closely with the AML/CTF Compliance Officer, escalating matters with clear evidence and supporting final risk decisions.

What You Will Work On

Customer Due Diligence (CDD/OCDD/ECDD): Operate the end to end customer due diligence lifecycle, from onboarding CDD (Customer Due Diligence) through trigger-based ECDD (Enhanced Customer Due Diligence) and Ongoing Customer Due Diligence (OCDD). Handle Identity Verification (IDV), review and reassess Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) outputs, and perform additional identity checks as required.
Transaction Monitoring: Review transaction monitoring alerts to identify structuring, unusual fund movements, and unexpected transaction patterns. Use the available monitoring channels to conduct investigations and escalations, and document the outcomes in clear reports.
Sanctions and Screening: Investigate alerts against global sanctions and PEP lists. Accurately discount false positives, and escalate true matches or higher risk profiles with clear evidence. Conduct adverse media searches where relevant.
Suspicious Matter Reporting (SMR) Support: Own internal investigations and draft clear, structured investigation memos and SMR drafts so that the AML/CTF Compliance Officer can make a final determination. Prepare the supporting evidence needed for AUSTRAC reporting, and maintain SMR registers and case files.
Quality Assurance (QA) and Operational Management: Conduct QA reviews and maintain AML operational metrics. Support management reporting and internal and external audit and review activities.
AML Systems Operations and Cross-Functional Support: Operate the in-house AML systems proficiently, and translate operational pain points and improvement needs into structured feedback and requirements for the engineering and product teams. In addition, provide clear responses and guidance on AML-related enquiries escalated from customer-facing channels (e.g., Customer Support) to enable consistent handling across the organisation.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have

5 + years of hands-on experience in AML/CTF operations (preferably within fintech, remittance service provider, e-money, payment institution, or banking environments)
End-to-End operational experience across customer due diligence (CDD/OCDD/ECDD), sanctions and PEP screening, risk assessment, and transaction monitoring
Analytical and critical thinking skills: able to go beyond checklist reviews, connect the dots in complex financial data, and make sound, independent risk-based judgments
Investigation and reporting: experience conducting internal investigations and drafting detailed escalation reports to support SMR filings
System proficiency: strong ability to use and adapt quickly to automated AML monitoring, screening, and case management tools
Communication: ability to articulate risks and investigation findings clearly in both written and verbal communication

Preferred

Familiarity with the Australian AML/CTF regulatory environment and AUSTRAC supervisory practices
Experience monitoring remittance or payment products
Experience working in a multicultural environment and collaborating with a global headquarters

What We Offer

Take ownership of the day to day operations of the Toss AU AML/CTF programme, which is already live, contributing to executing and continuously enhancing a stabilised framework
Work closely with the Toss AU AML/CTF Compliance Officer, owning the quality and consistency of Toss AU's AML operations
Where relevant, collaborate with the Korea headquarters AML team and other global functions to contribute to systems improvement and alignment with global standards
Competitive compensation package
Flexible and supportive work environment

Hiring Process

2 functional interviews (AML expertise, regulatory handling, execution capability)
2 culture fit interviews (e.g., way of working)

Please Note

Pre-employment checks, including a National Police Check and Bankruptcy Check, will be conducted as part of the hiring process.

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About The Position

Transform enterprise data into clear business insights, trusted metrics, and decision-ready reporting for Chevron stakeholders. The Data Analyst partners with business teams, Product Owners, data engineers, and subject-matter experts to define analytical requirements, validate data, build dashboards, investigate trends, and communicate actionable recommendations

Key Responsibilities

Business and analytical requirements

Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, processes, decisions, pain points, and key performance indicators.
Translate business questions into analytical requirements, metric definitions, data needs, acceptance criteria, and reporting specifications.
Facilitate discovery sessions and document assumptions, calculation logic, dimensions, filters, thresholds, and data ownership.
Maintain a business glossary and ensure consistent use of approved metric definitions across reports and dashboards.

Data analysis and insight generation

Use SQL, Excel, Power BI, Python, or approved analytical tools to profile, combine, validate, and analyze structured and semi-structured data.
Perform descriptive, diagnostic, trend, variance, segmentation, correlation, and root-cause analysis.
Identify patterns, risks, anomalies, operational gaps, and improvement opportunities; quantify business impact where supported by evidence.
Validate analytical results with subject-matter experts and clearly distinguish facts, assumptions, estimates, and recommendations.
Prepare concise insight summaries and decision support for operational teams, Product Owners, managers, and senior leaders.

Reporting and visualization

Design and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, KPI scorecards, and self-service analytical products.
Apply effective visualization, accessibility, drill-through, filtering, row-level security, and mobile-layout practices.
Develop DAX measures, Power Query transformations, calculated columns, and optimized data models.
Monitor report usage, performance, refresh reliability, and stakeholder adoption; automate recurring reporting where practical.

Data quality, governance, and collaboration

Perform data reconciliation and quality checks for completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness, duplicates, and outliers.
Work with data engineers and source-system owners to resolve defects and improve upstream data controls.
Follow Chevron requirements for cybersecurity, privacy, access control, confidential data, retention, and responsible use of analytics.
Document datasets, source-to-report logic, refresh schedules, ownership, known limitations, and support procedures.
Create backlog items in Azure DevOps, support Agile ceremonies, assist with UAT, and validate production releases.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, operations analysis, or a comparable role.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, data warehouses, or lakehouse platforms.
Hands-on Power BI experience including Power Query, DAX, data modeling, visual design, refresh, and row-level security.
Advanced Excel skills and ability to perform profiling, reconciliation, trend, variance, and root-cause analysis.
Experience translating business requirements into metrics, dashboards, analytical outputs, and acceptance criteria.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred qualifications
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or relevant Microsoft Fabric certification.
Experience with Python or R for manipulation, automation, statistics, or visualization.
Experience with Azure SQL, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or data lake environments.
Knowledge of forecasting, experimentation, process control, or anomaly detection.
Experience analyzing energy, refinery, commercial, customer, asset, emissions, supply-chain, or operational data.
Experience with Microsoft Purview, data catalogs, Agile/Scrum, SAFe, and Azure DevOps.

Success measures

Accurate and timely dashboards with clearly defined, traceable, and accepted metrics.
Reduced manual reporting effort and improved report refresh reliability.
Faster identification of performance gaps, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Higher stakeholder adoption and confidence in analytical products.
Documented insights that lead to measurable business decisions or process improvements.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

This role offers the opportunity to develop product expertise and analytical skills crucial to enhancing the profitability of global Property underwriting portfolio.

As a key team member, you will combine strong analytical capabilities, data-driven techniques and actuarial methodologies to analyze portfolios, enhance costing models and influence business decisions. You will work extensively with policy and costing data on Swiss Re's Stargate platform, taking ownership of key data products and developing analytical solutions to support portfolio impact assessments, reinsurance purchasing and underwriting decisions. Your work will directly contribute to portfolio steering, operational efficiency and the overall Business Unit's performance.

Key Responsibilities

Data Management & Analytical Development

Develop a comprehensive understanding of Property data flows across systems, from source to consumption.
Own and manage analytical data pipelines and transformations on Swiss Re’s Foundry-based data platform (Stargate). Collaborate with data engineering and technology teams to enhance data pipelines by defining business requirements and address data quality issues.

Translate complex data into meaningful insights and communicate findings to Underwriters, Portfolio Managers and other stakeholders

Pricing & Portfolio Management

Support actuarial pricing and portfolio profitability assessments using experience rating, exposure rating and other quantitative techniques.
Contribute to pricing model enhancements, actuarial rate reviews and the evaluation of costing parameters.
Independently conduct case pricing using actuarial methodologies and effectively communicate findings with Underwriters and key stakeholders
Deliver technical insights that support financial performance management and portfolio steering across sub-portfolios

We are a global team of actuarial and analytical professionals spread across Bangalore, Munich, Zurich, Manchester, London, New York, Windsor and Kansas City.

Our work combines actuarial expertise, data analytics and analytical development to improve pricing capabilities, generate portfolio insights and support data-driven business decisions. We collaborate closely with Underwriters, Portfolio Managers, Data Engineers and technology teams to develop practical solutions to complex business challenges. We play a critical role in supporting pricing decisions and steering one of the largest portfolios within the business.

We foster an inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives, collaboration and innovative thinking, offering opportunities to develop both technical and business expertise.

Experience with commercial property insurance products

Why Join Us?

Work in a multicultural, high-performing environment with global exposure
Influence high-impact portfolio decisions that shape business strategy
Collaborate with world-class experts across various business functions
Excellent opportunities for professional development and model innovation

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Bij Syngenta Crop Protection ontwikkelen we baanbrekende oplossingen die de wereldwijde voedselzekerheid beschermen en duurzame landbouw bevorderen. Als wereldmarktleider met ons hoofdkantoor in Zwitserland ondersteunen we telers met innovatieve gewasbeschermingstechnologieën die bestand zijn tegen de grootste uitdagingen van de natuur.

We combineren geavanceerde wetenschap met digitale oplossingen om slimme gewasbescherming te ontwikkelen die opbrengsten maximaliseert en tegelijk de impact op het milieu minimaliseert.

Sluit je aan bij onze missie om gewasbescherming van zaad tot oogst te vernieuwen.

Vacatureomschrijving

Technical Trial Data Analyst

Business Unit: Crop Protection B/NL
Afdeling: Technical Support
Locatie: Hybride en kantoor Bergen op Zoom

Als Technical Trial Data Analist vertaal je hoogwaardige data uit veldproeven naar heldere technische inzichten en overtuigende commerciële verhalen. Je helpt bij het plannen, uitvoeren en rapporteren van kleinschalige proeven en grootschalige split-fieldproeven bij telers. Daarmee versterk je technische introductieplannen, productdemonstraties en campagneondersteuning in België en Nederland.

Dit is een praktische, veldgerichte functie op het snijvlak van Technical Support, Sales, Marketing en Europese specialisten. Je combineert een solide proefopzet, data-analyse en visualisatie — waaronder data uit drones — met een goed begrip van de behoeften van telers en commerciële prioriteiten.

Wat ga je doen?

Een afgesproken portfolio van veldproeven voor gewasbescherming plannen, opzetten en uitvoeren: van de eerste voorbereiding tot dataverzameling (via Drones en gerichte bemonstering), analyse en eindrapportage, met een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid.
Datasets van meerdere proeven op commerciële bedrijven beheren, inclusief proefveldopzet, contact met telers en afstemming over vergoedingen.
Uitstekende proefkwaliteit waarborgen via robuust proefontwerp, kwaliteitsstandaarden en objectieve dataverzameling binnen herhaalde proeven en demonstratieproeven.
Proefdata verwerken en beheren in Syngenta-systemen, zodat betrouwbare data en interpretatie snel beschikbaar zijn.
Veld- en dronedata analyseren, kansen en knelpunten signaleren en heldere aanbevelingen doen voor projecten, introducties en campagnes.
Complexe datasets vertalen naar overtuigende presentaties, visualisaties en technische verhalen die Sales- en Marketingteams ondersteunen.
Effectieve demonstratielocaties ontwikkelen en uitvoeren, en bijdragen aan telersbijeenkomsten en activiteiten die klanten beïnvloeden.
Vertrouwde relaties opbouwen met lokale salesregio’s, Crop Advisors en Europese technische specialisten, en gedurende campagnecycli proactieve ondersteuning bieden.

Functie-eisen

Wat breng je mee?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Agronomie, Milieukunde, Landbouw of een verwante richting.
Ervaring met veldproeven, toepassingen met drones, data-analyse en data-interpretatie, bij voorkeur binnen gewasbescherming of een aangrenzende agrarische omgeving.
Goede kennis van proeftechnieken, waaronder herhaalde proeven en demonstratieproeven, en kwaliteitsstandaarden zoals GEP.
Ervaring met datamanagementtools (Bijv: Excel, QGIS, R/Python) en interesse in de toepassing van AI-ondersteunde methoden voor data-analyse.
Agronomische en productkennis, gecombineerd met inzicht in hoe technische informatiewaarde creëert in een commerciële omgeving.
Sterke communicatie- en presentatievaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met telers, klanten en collega’s op alle niveaus.
Een gestructureerde, proactieve en nauwkeurige werkwijze in projectuitvoering, met flexibiliteit om in te spelen op veranderende behoeften in het veld en de business.
Uitstekende beheersing van Nederlands, en goede beheersing van Engels.

About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The People Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

Build the people function from scratch, fast enough to keep up with 10x growth. You'll build the systems, programs, and team from nothing, and make them work before we outgrow them.
Reinvent people operations around AI. Doing this by hand doesn't scale to a workforce growing this fast on a team this lean. You'll put AI at the core of how the function runs, so a small team supports many times its number.
Shape the culture and comms as the company scales. When a company scales this quickly, staying connected and aligned doesn't happen on its own. You'll help shape internal comms, events, and rhythm that keep a multi-site team that's growing fast bound to a shared culture.

Role Scope

Own Fluidstack's benefits program end to end, covering medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D, disability, EAP, FSA, HSA, HRA, commuter, voluntary benefits, and the 401(k) with Fidelity, and decide which new benefits (fertility, family-building, mental health) we add next.
Run annual renewal and open enrollment start to finish: model claims, cost trends, and contribution options with Finance, benchmark against AI and technology peers, bring recommendations to leadership well before enrollment, and audit every election across HRIS, payroll, and carrier systems afterward.
Keep every plan compliant as we expand into new states and entities, covering ERISA, ACA reporting (1094-C and 1095-C), COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, Section 125, plan documents and required notices, state paid leave laws, and audit readiness.
Run benefits operations in our HRIS and carrier feeds so eligibility, deductions, and life events stay accurate every pay cycle, and hold brokers, carriers, and TPAs to their service levels through renewals, RFPs, and implementations.
Administer leave and accommodations (FMLA, state paid leave, disability, parental, and military leave) with carriers, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and Legal, and serve as the go-to expert when an employee's benefits question is complex, urgent, or personal.

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,
tell us where you would
.

You've owned a US benefits program end to end, from broker and carrier renewal through open enrollment and the post-enrollment audit of every election.
You've personally handled benefits compliance (ERISA, ACA reporting and affordability testing, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, Section 125) and you know exactly where your knowledge ends and benefits counsel begins.

You've been the primary admin of an HRIS and benefits platform (Rippling), including eligibility rules and carrier EDI feeds, and you reconcile HRIS, payroll, and carrier data in spreadsheets yourself.
You've built benefits cost and utilization reporting, modeled renewal and contribution scenarios with Finance, and driven leadership to a decision on cost versus coverage.

You handle confidential health and personal data with discretion, and you build checks so a missed enrollment or payroll error never happens twice.
Bonus: Benefits certifications (CEBS, CBP). Hypergrowth benefits builds (headcount doubling or more in a year, new states and entities). International benefits (UK, employer of record).
